purpose: Map measured Agent Lee training-step efficiency and quality into runtime-state-v1 so the canonical Formula can govern training scheduling without modifying LEEWAY-FORMULA-v1.0.

dimensions.role: actual tokens admitted to the weight-training step after deterministic externalization/deduplication
peak training working-set pressure against available memory
time waiting for compute/training lane admission
change in frozen Agent Lee validation score versus previous accepted checkpoint
loss on frozen general-capability/retention tests caused by the training step

observationWindow.rule: 16 consecutive comparable micro-batches under one base model, adapter method, dataset revision, hyperparameter profile and evaluation suite.

computeFunnel: Externalize skills, tools, Formula facts, device actions and current ecosystem state before weight training.
Deduplicate and cluster examples before batching.
Benchmark candidate worker/concurrency counts on the actual training host; do not assume maximum parallelism is efficient.
Prioritize persona/truth/strategy examples before lower-value repetition.
Measure validation gain and interference after every bounded training block.
Stop or reduce compute when marginal verified gain stabilizes, interference rises, memory pressure crosses budget, or queue/thermal pressure dominates.
Only verified improvements progress to the next training phase.

currentEvidence.claimBoundary: Token-proxy routing reduction only; no FLOP, energy, wall-clock or gradient-step reduction is claimed yet.

calibration.rule: Collect measured training traces for all six dimensions before numeric Formula evaluation.

nextGate: Run bounded training-host micro-benchmarks for distillation, continued pretraining, QLoRA/DoRA and DPO; collect 16x6 traces; calibrate ranges; then request Veritas acceptance.
